# Senior Platform Engineer

**Meridian Systems** — Remote (US)

## About the role

We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the developer platform that every
product team at Meridian ships on. You will design the paved road, not police it.

## What you will do

- Own our Kubernetes platform end to end, from cluster upgrades to workload admission
  policy.
- Build and maintain Terraform modules that product teams consume without reading them.
- Run the CI/CD system, and keep a full build under ten minutes.
- Carry the pager one week in six, and lead blameless incident reviews.

## What we are looking for

- 5+ years operating production systems on AWS or GCP.
- Strong Go or Python, and the judgement to know which one a problem wants.
- Deep Kubernetes experience: you have debugged a CNI, not just applied YAML.
- Infrastructure as code as a default, Terraform preferred.
- Observability practice grounded in SLOs, not dashboards for their own sake.

## Nice to have

- Experience with eBPF based tooling.
- A track record of reducing cloud spend without hurting reliability.
- Public writing or conference talks about platform work.

## Compensation and benefits

$185,000 – $225,000 base, plus equity. Remote first within the United States.
